description: A matched test file that declares no tests fails: Jest's scheduler turns a result with no test results into "Your test suite must contain at least one test." (TestScheduler.ts onResult), so the helper under __tests__ (caught by the default testMatch) and the file that holds only an empty describe are FAIL lines, counted as failed suites, and the run exits 1, next to a passing file. The tree is data (D13). One Jest worker, the default reporter and --json.
